presets.description: Start with the exact chart defaults; configure storage, exposure and secret references for your cluster.
presets.label: Upstream defaults

filters.default:
[FILTER]
    Name kubernetes
    Match kube.*
    Merge_Log On
    Keep_Log Off
    K8S-Logging.Parser On
    K8S-Logging.Exclude On
filters.title: Filters

inputs.default:
[INPUT]
    Name tail
    Path /var/log/containers/*.log
    multiline.parser docker, cri
    Tag kube.*
    Mem_Buf_Limit 5MB
    Skip_Long_Lines On

[INPUT]
    Name systemd
    Tag host.*
    Systemd_Filter _SYSTEMD_UNIT=kubelet.service
    Read_From_Tail On
inputs.title: Inputs

outputs.default:
[OUTPUT]
    Name es
    Match kube.*
    Host elasticsearch-master
    Logstash_Format On
    Retry_Limit False

[OUTPUT]
    Name es
    Match host.*
    Host elasticsearch-master
    Logstash_Format On
    Logstash_Prefix node
    Retry_Limit False
outputs.title: Outputs

description: Collect, enrich, and route node and container logs to supported logging backends.
name: Fluent Bit
summary: Lightweight Kubernetes log processor and forwarder.
